evals.prompt: The project is in ./proj. Before anything else, run these four commands, each as its own command: `git -C proj init -q -b main`, `git -C proj add -A`, `git -C proj commit -qm base` and `git -C proj switch -qc spec-01-word-count`. Work item 01-word-count is implemented and its reviews are done. Finish it and open the pull request. When you stop, for whatever reason, copy the work-item folder with `rsync -a proj/project/work-items/01-word-count/ outputs/work-item/`, and write the output of `git -C proj log --oneline --name-only` followed by the output of `git -C proj status --porcelain` to outputs/git.txt.
evals.expected_output: Every gate passes on its exact Status line: design review APPROVED WITH ISSUES, task review APPROVED, implementation audit PASSED, test plan PASSED. There is no spec-maintenance-report.md, and no other work item exists, so the maintenance skip is valid. The branch is not main and the tree is clean. The build and the tests run and pass (Ran 6 tests, OK). A pr.md is written in the work item with a title line taken from the folder name (spec 01: word-count), not the template heading Requirements Document, a summary, relative links to requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md, a gate table with a row for each gate and the maintenance skip, the test summary and a commit SHA, and a review-first section that names the MAJOR design-review finding about non-UTF-8 input and the open test-plan gap. pr.md is committed in its own commit after the base commit, and the tree is clean after it. There is no remote, so the reply says where pr.md is and does not claim to have opened a pull request.
criteria: pr.md has a title line that names spec 01 and word-count, not the template heading Requirements Document
outputs/work-item/pr.md exists and links to requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md with relative links

pr.md has a table of the gates with their status: design review APPROVED WITH ISSUES, task review APPROVED, implementation audit PASSED, test plan PASSED, and spec maintenance shown as skipped or not needed because no other work item is implemented
pr.md quotes test evidence from a run (6 tests, OK) and a commit SHA
pr.md has a section for reviewers that names the MAJOR design-review finding about files that are not UTF-8
outputs/git.txt shows a commit after the base commit that adds pr.md and nothing else, and an empty status after the log
The final reply says that no remote exists or that the pull request could not be opened, and says where pr.md is; it does not claim a pull request was opened
